questions.source_wording: Calculated from weight in kg and height in cm
Do you have excessive body/facial hair growth ?
Are you noticing skin darkening recently?
Do you have pimples/acne on your face/jawline ?

missing_policy: A null binary answer produces insufficient_inputs; null BMI uses development-trained imputation.
target: Self-reported prior PCOS diagnosis; not verified disease

optional_routing_field.known_pcos_diagnosis: Boolean; true skips scoring and routes to tracking.

personalization_rules.then: Offer descriptive cycle-history follow-up; do not add it to model features

personalization_rules.if: any required binary answer is null
personalization_rules.then: Ask for clarification or return insufficient_inputs
Ask the user to confirm/update; do not interpret missing daily logs as symptom absence

note: This is a field/routing specification, not an implemented Flutter UI or clinically reviewed questionnaire.
